Common complaints include: "Perdí todo por señales falsas de influencers" (I lost everything due to fake signals from influencers), "Estafas en crypto me arruinaron" (Crypto scams ruined me), and frustration with "complejidad del análisis on-chain" (complexity of on-chain analysis) leading to impulsive losses.
